about.description:
jetson-stats is a powerful tool to analyze your board, you can use with a stand alone application with jtop or import in your python script, the main features are:

- Decode hardware, architecture, L4T and NVIDIA Jetpack
- Monitoring, CPU, GPU, Memory, Engines, fan
- Control NVP model, fan speed, jetson_clocks
- Importable in a python script
- Dockerizable in a container
- Do not need super user
- Tested on many different hardware configurations
- Works with all NVIDIA Jetpack

name: jetson-stats
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: 7.2.1

package:
  name: jetson-stats
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
- url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/j/jetson-stats/jetson_stats-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 90f74f817a2327d001fc0e9e2a348b78b048b718567a4236b3207a6b756f4d0f

build:
  skip: win
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
    - jetson_config = jtop.jetson_config:main
    - jetson_release = jtop.jetson_release:main
    - jetson_swap = jtop.jetson_swap:main
    - jtop = jtop.__main__:main
  noarch: python

requirements:
  host:
  - python ${{ python_min }}.*
  - setuptools >=61.0
  - wheel
  - pip
  run:
  - python >=${{ python_min }}
  - smbus2
  - distro
  - nvidia-ml-py >=13.595.45

tests:
- python:
    pip_check: true
    python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
    imports:
    - jtop
- script:
    - jtop --version
  requirements:
    run:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
- script:
    - jtop --version

about:
  summary: Interactive system-monitor and process viewer for all NVIDIA Jetson [Thor, Orin, Xavier, Nano, TX] series
  description: |
    jetson-stats is a powerful tool to analyze your board, you can use with a stand alone application with jtop or import in your python script, the main features are:

    - Decode hardware, architecture, L4T and NVIDIA Jetpack
    - Monitoring, CPU, GPU, Memory, Engines, fan
    - Control NVP model, fan speed, jetson_clocks
    - Importable in a python script
    - Dockerizable in a container
    - Do not need super user
    - Tested on many different hardware configurations
    - Works with all NVIDIA Jetpack
  license: AGPL-3.0-only
  license_file:
  - LICENSE
  documentation: https://rnext.it/jetson_stats
  repository: https://github.com/rbonghi/jetson_stats
  homepage: https://rnext.it/jetson_stats

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ruben-arts
